events.title: Demo Patch 3: Corrupted Cores & Idle Farming Goals
events.summary: Demo Patch 3: Corrupted Cores & Idle Farming GoalsGreetings, Summoners!The third Soulstonia Demo patch is here! This update focuses on adding idle farming goals and Corrupted Cores to the game. Corrupted Cores are an evil blight on Soulstonia that you can purify by defeating the enemies that spawn from them. After completing three waves, tons of loot drops and the core is restored. Restored Cores breathe magic back into the world.ChangesAdded Corrupted Cores to the worldAdded idle farming goals

events.title: Demo Patch 2: Easier Questing & Better Idle Goals
events.summary: Demo Patch 2: Easier Questing & Better Idle GoalsGreetings, Summoners!The second Soulstonia Demo patch is here! This update focuses on making the idle goals and quests easier to manage and interact with. This includes editing an re-ordering idle goals on the fly, as well as having easier access to starting and continuing quests from the quest panel.ChangesQuests in the quest panel now have arrow buttons like in the HUDGoals now properly queue the next one on completionAdded plus and minus button
